subject: Television & Streaming
title: Downton Abbey and the Heritage Export
description: A fast breakdown of Downton Abbey and the Heritage Export for builders.

hook.text: Downton Abbey depicted the British aristocracy with gorgeous sets, impeccable costumes, and class dynamics.

buildup.text: Julian Fellowes wrote the series as a meditation on social change.

discovery.text: Downton became PBS's highest-rated drama and spawned two feature films.

twist.text: Critics noted the show romanticized inequality. Servants were shown as content in their station.

climax.text: Downton Abbey proved that British period drama has a permanent global audience.

punchline.text: The world watched British aristocracy and wished they could serve tea.

quiz.question: What criticism has been leveled against Downton Abbey's portrayal of class?
options: It romanticized inequality by showing servants as content in their hierarchical roles
It focused too much on the aristocracy
